title: ETH0
tagline: Decentralized AI orchestration for smart contracts. ETH0 lets you build, deploy, and automate on-chain strategies using AI agents integrated with DeFi protocols like Aave, Lido, and Uniswap.
description: ETH0 is an AI-powered platform designed for seamless smart contract automation on Ethereum. Users can create on-chain workflows through a drag-and-drop IDE, deploy custom AIR (AI Orchestration) smart contracts, and integrate with DeFi protocols like Aave, Lido, and Uniswap. The system connects on-chain smart contracts with AI inference models, enabling dynamic strategy execution based on real-time data. ETH0 brings AI-driven efficiency to DeFi, allowing both developers and non-technical users to create complex financial automations effortlessly.
how_its_made:
ETH0 is built with a modular architecture combining front-end and smart contract development. The front-end uses React with a custom drag-and-drop IDE for generating Solidity smart contracts. Foundry is used for smart contract development and deployment, ensuring efficient on-chain interactions.

For AI orchestration, ETH0 integrates Hugging Face models for inference, LangChain for agent framework management, and LlamaIndex to handle complex data retrieval and contextual AI reasoning. On the backend, Supabase is used as the database and authentication layer, providing real-time data sync with smart contracts. The AI inference connects seamlessly with on-chain events, allowing dynamic automation of DeFi strategies using protocols like Aave, Lido, and Uniswap. The entire stack is deployed on DigitalOcean for scalable, high-performance infrastructure.
